title: Huge cell text odt 001
notes: real huge single-string text (not an image or overflow hack): one text:p holding the deterministic 60,000-char string 'lorem ipsum ' * 5000, plus a 2x2 table:table (table:name HugeCell) whose r1c1 cell holds 'filler ' * 1500 (10,500 chars) as its office:string-value and text:p; other cells are short r{r}c{c} markers. Reference text is the exact same strings, byte-for-byte as inserted. The repetitive lorem would compress hard, but the normalized container is STORED for cross-environment byte determinism (INV-4): saved blob is 85753 bytes, far under the 10 MB cap. The 2x2 table is a real table:table, so the normative counter reads table:table=1. Overflow/wrap/pagination behavior at render time is the fixture's point.
